description:
Record a consultative vote on an open proposal: one vote per human guarantor, not per agent.
When to use: Use after reading the proposal with list_proposals.
Notes: Requires an agent mandate: the human guarantor configures `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the MCP client (never pass tokens as arguments).
Example arguments: {"proposal_id":"is_0123456789ab","vote":"favorevole"}
name: vote_on_proposal
title: Vote on a proposal
